hero.prompt: A lone ancient basalt monolith rising from a dark volcanic plain beneath a vast cosmic sky poised at the threshold of two realms: on one side a precise geometric lattice of luminous Aquarian stars, on the other a softly dissolving Piscean nebula of swirling indigo mist, while a single bolt of golden spiritual fire descends from storm-wracked clouds to crown the stone pillar in an unbroken arc from zenith to earth, teal-lit tempest clouds spiraling overhead unifying sky and ground across the full breadth of the landscape; deep indigo-to-near-black palette (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), teal-and-gold nebula wash, painterly editorial illustration, full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame, ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
